sources.publisher: Office of the President, Republic of China (Taiwan)
sources.title: Ma Ying-jeou: official presidential chronology and 2008–2016 term
sources.findings: Read the official presidential chronology, term header, administrative appointments and election entries. The page groups educational qualifications under the birth-year row; those degrees were not earned in 1950. Justice-minister appointment is 1993, correcting the 1996 claim in the NCUSCR event profile. Promotional descriptions of governance and success are not independent evaluation. Election dates, accession and party office remain distinct.

sources.title: 2012年总统副总统当选人公告：出生日期与搭档得票
sources.findings: Read the 2012 elected-president/vice-president announcement table in the CEC compilation. ROC year 39 converts to 1950; the July 13 birthday belongs to Ma, not the adjoining running-mate entry. The 6,891,139 total is the joint ticket’s vote. January 19 announcement is not January 14 polling or inauguration. No entire 5897-line compilation review claimed.

sources.title: 2023 interview profile: legal education and cross-strait career
sources.findings: Read the NCUSCR event profile and actual-recording description. Use the 1972 NTU, 1976 NYU LL.M. and 1981 Harvard S.J.D. chronology, cross-checked against official degree names. Its 1996 justice-minister accession conflicts with the official 1993 chronology and is rejected. Its broad first-senior-official mainland-visit claim is not copied. Do not infer an ongoing academic appointment or a current health assessment from an old interview. Video not watched.

sources.title: 历任市长名册：马英九两届任期及继任者
sources.findings: Read the Taipei mayor roster and adjacent predecessor/successor entries. Ma’s two terms are listed 25 December 1998–24 December 2002 and 25 December 2002–24 December 2006; Hau succeeds December 25. Some historical summaries use handover day as the endpoint, but the public page follows the explicit roster’s last-service-day convention. December 25 is accession, not election day. No current mayoral office or solitary authorship of all city development is implied.

sources.title: Fifth Chiang–Chen Talks: June 2010 schedule and ECFA signing
sources.findings: Read SEF’s fifth-talks schedule and ECFA signing section. June 28 preparatory talks and page date differ from actual June 29 signature. The authorized organizations’ heads signed, not Ma. Cooperation objectives and anticipated growth are not a measured causal economic result or proof all planned tariff measures were immediately implemented.

sources.title: 2010年产业服务电子报：ECFA签署、生效及早期收获安排
sources.findings: Read the December 2010 ministry newsletter’s substantive opening. It distinguishes June 29 signature, September 12 entry into force and the forthcoming January 2011 early-harvest timetable. Historical product lists and tariff promises are not claimed to remain unchanged in November 2026; the dossier does not audit current suspension measures or every line of the agreement.

sources.title: 太阳花运动十周年回顾：2014年3月18日至4月10日
sources.findings: Read the CNA Sunflower retrospective opening and dated chronology. Chamber occupation began March 18, 2014, after the March 17 review dispute and lasted to April 10. Publication/update in March 2024 is a retrospective, not a new occupation. The later services agreement is not ECFA itself. Subsequent electoral and party changes are not attributed solely to the protest or to one individual.

sources.title: 2015年11月7日新加坡马习会实际会谈报道
sources.findings: Read CNA’s November 7 report confirming the Singapore meeting and post-talk press conferences. It is a completed meeting account rather than the earlier departure or advance-arrival notice. Discussion and symbolic first meeting do not themselves establish settlement of sovereignty disputes or comprehensive political agreement.

sources.title: 2024年4月10日北京马习会：前总统身份及双方讲话
sources.findings: Read the April 10, 2024 CNA meeting report and relevant remarks. Actual date is April 10, not April 8 predicted in an earlier report, nor April 12 update. Ma attended as a former president. Competing political claims about identity, the 1992 consensus and reunification are attributed positions, not universally accepted legal conclusions or achieved outcomes.

sources.title: 2026年7月8日三中案马英九等人无罪确定
sources.findings: Read the July 8, 2026 CNA final-outcome report. Supreme Court dismissal of prosecution appeal makes Ma’s acquittal final; do not retain December 2025 provisional status or February 2026 appeal as current. Other defendants’ convictions, including Tsai Cheng-yuan’s separate counts, do not belong to Ma. This is a reported judicial acquittal, not non-prosecution; the original full judgment and dossier were not obtained.

sources.title: 2026年7月10日报道：无罪确定后声明及7月9日与朱立伦会面
sources.findings: Read United Daily’s July 10 report, distinguishing the July 8 final judicial outcome and July 9 meeting with Eric Chu from publication. The text reports an actual visit and attributes foundation claims about routine office attendance. The social-media photo was not visually inspected. July birthday wishes are not evidence of a November appearance, nor do they verify or refute private medical claims.

sources.title: 2026年11月12日基金会另案调查：检方回应、指控与否认
sources.findings: Read the November 12 Mirror Daily report quoting prosecutors about November 5 questioning in the separate foundation-finance matter. It includes allegations and denials; investigation is not conviction. Ma/the foundation’s complaint is not a new guilty verdict against Ma, and questioning of King Pu-tsung cannot be treated as Ma’s own attendance. No primary investigation file, final finding or health diagnosis verified.
